| `official.workforce.setup.generation_review` | Read the existing whole-document generation reconciliation as ShiftId-ordered before/after/change rows and exact totals. | `official.workforce.setup.rule_page` | Read stable-ID-ordered rule summaries in one class. Omitted or null kindId selects all; a supplied kindId must be an existing catalog kind in that class. Omitted limit defaults to 50; explicit limits are 1–200. |
| `official.workforce.setup.rule_scope` | Inspect the existing scope helpers over the full captured horizon with exact people, shift and Cartesian population counts and a stable-ID page for the selected axis.
